Section: Nimbus Labs Data Retention Policy > Retention schedule

Data type: Customer data (transaction files, reconciliation results); Retention: For the contract term plus 90 days
Data type: Application and system logs; Retention: 400 days
Data type: Database backups; Retention: 35 days
Data type: Support tickets; Retention: 3 years
Data type: Security audit logs; Retention: 7 years
Data type: Employee records; Retention: 7 years after the end of employment

Section: Nimbus Labs SOC 2 Type II Summary > Next examination

The next Type II audit period begins 1 July 2026 and runs for 12 months.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs SOC 2 Type II Summary > Results

The auditor noted two exceptions during the period:

One quarterly access review was completed 6 days after the due date in Q1 2026.One terminated contractor retained read-only access to a staging tool for 2 days after their contract ended.

Both exceptions were remediated and closed before the report was issued. No exceptions related to encryption, backups or incident response.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs SOC 2 Type II Summary > Overview

Nimbus Labs completed a SOC 2 Type II examination covering the Nimbus Ledger Sync platform. The audit period ran from 1 January 2026 to 30 June 2026. The final report was issued on 14 August 2026 by the independent auditor Harlow & Pike LLP.

title: Knowledge Doc
content:
Section: Nimbus Labs Onboarding and Offboarding Procedure > Offboarding

The manager notifies HR on or before the last working day.All access is revoked within 4 hours of the person's exit time.Shared secrets that the person had access to are rotated within 2 business days.The company laptop is returned, and the device is wiped within 3 business days.Offboarding is recorded in the audit log and checked in the next quarterly access review.
